item.title: China's BYD set to overtake Tesla as top EV seller
item.description:
📝 On Thursday, BYD said that sales of its battery-powered cars rose last year by almost 28% to more than 2. Tesla sales slumped in the first three months of 2025 after a backlash against Musk's role in US President Donald Trump's administration. Those commitments, along with running Trump's Department of Government Efficiency (Doge), led some investors to suggest that Musk was not focusing enough on Tesla.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj9rjwpvmpzo
